verdict.rationale: Crossmint has a live interactive API reference (call APIs directly from the browser) and llms.txt for AI ingestion, suggesting an underlying machine-readable spec, but a direct probe of common OpenAPI spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404s, so no downloadable OpenAPI/spec file was found. missing for 10: a publicly discoverable/downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file, confirmation that the API reference is generated from a spec accessible to users.
